purpose: Read-only source/log diagnosis of existing pending original-QA result event

logs.limits: Filtered metadata only; no log body, credentials, prompts or replies exported. No claim about records outside this bounded window.

logs.grep: Governance event remains pending for original recovery|Original governance recovery retained its fence|Governance event remains durably pending|ERP outbox recovery unavailable|Governance reconciliation preserved project
logs.limit: Source-selected log families only; no raw detail/status/endpoint body retained.

Governance event remains pending for original recovery

confirmed_source_path: receive_erp_event HMAC-verifies and durably stores first; created events alone spawn _process_event.
_process_event requires _gate -> _erp_project fresh Project/assignment/ToDo reads before handling result.recorded. Non-403/409 HTTPException propagates without acknowledging the inbox.
_spawn logs only the exception class, with no event identity/status/cause or traceback.
Current configured private transport uses an 8-second request timeout. ERPClient GET may attempt three times with 1 and 2 second backoffs.
reconciliation_loop is created at application startup. It processes pending inbox events, then calls _recover_project for enrolled Projects, then sleeps RECONCILE_SECONDS=1800.

Per-Project sweeper recovery can call read_original before fresh ERP packet/authority checks. This can persist only the verified original relay receipt and original reply while later publication remains blocked.
Original gateway receipt route only checks exact stored admission equality; it does not reacquire a lease or require the old PID alive.
QA blocked result bypasses the QA pass-only Git/workspace/test verification branch. The uncertain repository.verify_delivery call is not executed again by result acceptance.
complete_original still requires exact original implementation identity, current task fence/token, registered binding, unchanged business context and current ERP control.
After durable exact Native ACK, publication_receipt invokes governed_receipt and settle_reference for the same existing admission. It does not create a replacement lease or change gate epoch.

log_inference.interpretation: The delay is consistent with three 8-second ERP GET attempts plus 1+2-second backoff on the initial authority path. Native authority/connection failure is the supported hypothesis; the bounded logs cannot prove the exact endpoint, status or underlying exception.

existing_recovery_sequence: Restore and verify Native ERP health without changing the original event, reply, call, lease or packet.
Allow the existing reconciliation loop to consume the pending event / recover the same original. No new event or Native Retry is needed to record the existing blocked result.

If the provider still lacks a receipt, the normal reader observes the already submitted original and records its verified receipt; it does not ingest the protected offline JSON file automatically and does not submit a model.

Fresh packet/business/control checks precede canonical result/Native publication. On unknown publication ACK, the result store records uncertain and later performs exact receipt readback instead of another model submission.
Verify canonical blocked result, durable Native Blocked receipt, provider delegated state and the same admission settled before treating original reconciliation as complete.

Any future independent QA requires separately reviewed policy, real Pending Review readiness, newer acknowledged human Retry and ordinary fresh dispatch gates. Closing PM still requires genuine independent QA pass.
